description: Bring your sunglasses, because Team Gamma Ray is here to shine! We are a high-energy crew of space enthusiasts who bring warmth, humor, and explosive creativity to every lab challenge and brainteaser.
summary: In 2110, a young astronaut and his robot assistant (Echo-7) detect an unusual musical signal from Voyager 1's Golden Record at the edge of the solar system. Traveling there, they discover the Earth music is peacefully attracting cosmic creatures in the Harmonic Nebula. When a radiation storm damages the transmitter and threatens to turn the creatures hostile, the astronaut quickly repairs it to restore harmony—proving that music and knowledge can unite the universe.
